set.description:
— s2a:meta —
version:    1.0.0
status:     active
updated:    2026-08-04
changelog:
  1.0.0   2026-08-04  init         Initial release

A merchandising card for a product plan — plan name, pricing, a feature list, and CTAs — used in pricing tables and plan comparisons. The highlight variant is the featured / recommended plan.

## Good to know
- MerchCard is mode-aware — you don’t pin it. Drop it on any surface and it adapts; only the highlight .body is intentionally pinned Light.
- Two styles: default and highlight. Highlight is the featured plan — its .body pins to Light mode at the COMPONENT level on purpose, keeping the featured body a white surface in both light and dark themes. This is an intentional, documented definition-level pin — never pin at the instance level.
- Features List: default shows the full feature list; closed collapses it.
- Content comes through slots: pricing/plan options in the options slot, the feature list in the features slot. Plan Name and Description are text props.
- Optional regions toggle independently: Show Options, Show Pricing, Show Secondary CTA.
- Composed from real S2A sub-components — ProductLockup, PricingDisplay, SelectPromo, Button — v2, TrustBadge, FeatureSection + ListItem — so it inherits their tokens and behavior.

## Accessibility
- The Plan Name is the card's accessible name — make it a heading so the plan is announced and the card is navigable by structure. WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 2.4.6 Headings and Labels.
- The feature list must be a real list (<ul>) so assistive tech announces the item count and each feature. WCAG 1.3.1.
- Pricing is content, not decoration — expose the price and interval as text, not an image. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
- Primary and secondary CTAs are distinct focusable actions with clear names — not one ambiguous target. WCAG 2.4.4 Link Purpose.
- Don't signal "recommended" with color alone — pair the highlight with a text label (e.g. "Most popular"). WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color.
- Contrast: the highlight body stays light (dark text on white) in both themes by design; verify the default cards' text clears 4.5:1 on their surface in both modes. WCAG 1.4.3.
